reviewPolicy.executionAuthority: Only oracleEvidence records execution here; absence means no execution evidence in this catalog, not a claimed failure or pass.

finalDispositions.adopted-required: Already in the executable required manifest; metadata does not refresh execution or qualify support.
finalDispositions.support-fixture: Reviewed fixture role, not a functional passing program.
finalDispositions.upstream-excluded-negative-example: Reviewed expected-failure source role; not executed by this inventory.
finalDispositions.implementation-internal: This exact whole source targets reviewed implementation representation or a VM-specific execution path. Does not reject the module or any separate public subset.
finalDispositions.unsupported-capability: Exact reviewed source requires the explicitly recorded unavailable capability on named current hosts; not a universal API waiver or a pass.
finalDispositions.rejected-low-value: This exact source is deliberately not selected for behavioral adoption due to limited behavioral value or hardcoded implementation/host expectations; not a claim that its public API is unsupported.

backlogDispositions.high-value-backlog: Useful reviewed semantics remain implementation/oracle/adoption work. Mixed selection constraints remain binding; no passing or required status.
backlogDispositions.case-selection-backlog: Select and attribute the public case subset before execution/adoption; representation, host, resource, version or dormant-source boundaries remain open.
backlogDispositions.smoke-only-backlog: Only limited active smoke value identified; no broad behavioral coverage or final rejection inferred.
backlogDispositions.suite-adapter-needed: Honest fixture, isolation, invocation, output or selected-case work is needed before oracle eligibility; not a universal unsupported capability.
